about: Every workspace view's query and every resource kind's URL (GOAL_FOUNDATIONS A6). views: the params a view's screen reads, in the order hrefs write them; a param at its default is left out of the URL. kinds: the view that opens a resource, the param that names it, and any other param its URL requires. A default or automatic selection never writes the URL. oms/app/workspace_routes.py is the server's copy; oms/test_workspace_routes.py holds them equal.
